verdict.rationale: Latham & Watkins offers digital tools (the LathamDrive document generator, the Book of Jargon app and its text search), so natural-language operation is a fair axis for its offering. However, no evidence shows any natural-language command interface or AI assistant. A glossary text search box is an adjacent feature, not natural-language operation, and the probes found no llms.txt or API surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
